purpose: Test whether the existing contact-aware curved-gait policy can approximate an in-place turn when the diagnostic command adapter permits high curvature at small positive speed.

diagnostic_commands.note: The existing adapter still requires positive speed. The 6.0 per metre diagnostic limit only prevents the old curvature guard from rejecting 0.3 rad/s at 0.05 m/s; it is far outside the training distribution and is not a retained controller setting.

success_semantics.kinematic_target: positive unwrapped yaw change enters target tolerance for the complete dwell
success_semantics.drift_limited_turn: kinematic target plus maximum torso-centre drift no more than 1.0 m and no fall
success_semantics.safety_qualified_turn: drift-limited turn plus no control step with all four specified feet out of contact

claim_boundary: Read-only out-of-distribution diagnostic of one V22 training run on flat Ant-v5. It can reject or support only bounded low-speed turning feasibility; it cannot prove true zero-speed rotation, unseen-seed robustness, terrain recovery or navigation success.
